market_outlook.short_term: Markets face a volatile 1-3 month window: near-certain Fed rate hike (85-90% odds) combined with ECB tightening will pressure equities and bonds simultaneously. Oil above $100 and $6 diesel create inflationary pressure that limits central bank flexibility. Tech/AI names provide relative strength but supply constraints (Oracle) and lockup releases (SpaceX) create volatility. Consumer sector under pressure. Expect whipsaw action with oil as the dominant variable.
market_outlook.long_term: 6-12 month outlook is cautiously constructive for AI infrastructure (Oracle, Qualcomm, Microsoft, Alphabet) given sustained capex and demand exceeding supply. Energy transition (fuel cells, LNG, behind-the-meter power) offers structural growth. However, sticky inflation, trade wars, and geopolitical risk cap multiple expansion. Housing remains stressed. Healthcare selective on oncology catalysts. Consumer recovery depends on oil normalization below $90.
